ambient_events: A delegation sweeps through the Concordat, flanked by lawyers like an honour guard.
The great handshake mural is being repainted, slightly, to reflect the new terms.
description: The treaty hall where the corporations that own Coldwater sign the accords that carve it up, beneath a mural of a handshake so large and so insincere it loops in the mind for hours.
name: The Concordat
